recentItems.title: This Is the One Thing I’ll Never Do Again in GTA 6
recentItems.description:
Regrets, I’ve had a few. But none in my over 100 hours with GTA 6 are quite like this.

It all began on a quiet afternoon in Vice City. It was a perfect day as the sun hung high in the sky, casting long shadows across the beach as vacation-goers and locals alike enjoyed the weather. An even darker, more sinister shadow would soon be cast over the city, though. A slice of paradise soon to be tarnished by the actions of one curious deviant: Me.
I visited the zoo in GTA 6 to commit the worst crime imaginable, and now I feel terrible. 

#IGN #Gaming #GTA6

recentItems.title: Don't miss these items from GTA 6 chapter 1!
Worms: Galactic Tactics - Official Gameplay Overview Trailer
recentItems.description:
Get a deep dive into Worms: Galactic Tactics in this new trailer for the upcoming 3D turn-based tactical roguelike game. Learn about combat in fully destructible arenas, weapons, how to upgrade and reinvent classic Worms weapons, and more. In Worms: Galactic Tactics, climb the ranks of the Galactic Gauntlet and take down the magnificent Emperor Flugg! 

Worms: Galactic Tactics will be available on Steam, Nintendo Switch, Xbox Series X/S, and PlayStation 5 (PS5) in 2027.

recentItems.title: Hell Let Loose - Official Lake Balaton Update 22 Teaser Trailer
recentItems.description:
Get a look at the Lake Balaton Update 22 Teaser Trailer for Hell Let Loose, a first-person World War 2 shooter developed by Expression Games. recentItems.title: Arcade Dreams - Official Trailer (2026) Documentary
recentItems.description:
Take a look at the Official Trailer for Arcade Dreams, an upcoming video game history documentary distributed by Uncork’d Entertainment. Explore over a century of arcade history and the games, innovators, and passionate communities that shaped gaming culture in Arcade Dreams, which releases digitally and On Demand on November 27.

Arcade Dreams centers on the clatter of pinball machines and the glow of classic arcade cabinets and the immersive experiences of modern virtual reality. The documentary celebrates the innovation, creativity, and community that have kept arcade culture alive for more than a century.

Arcade Dreams is directed by Zach Weddington and takes the audience on a whirlwind tour through arcade gaming, from the penny arcades of the early 1900s and the golden age of pinball to the explosion of video games in the 1970s and 1980s and today's arcade renaissance.

The documentary is produced by Rock Steady Media, the team behind cult classic Viva Amiga; the documentary features cinematography by Emmy Award winner Bill Winters (Jeffrey Epstein: Filthy Rich, Comedians in Cars Getting Coffee, Martha), with JoBlo founder Berge Garabedian also involved in the production.

Arcade Dreams is releasing digitally and On Demand on November 27.

recentItems.title: GTA 6 - How to Get the Kingpin Bowling Safe Code
recentItems.description:
The Kingpin Bowling Alley illegal operation opens up in chapter 2, and most people likely go through it noticing a safe with no nearby safe code. It turns out that you actually need to collect this code from a completely different location. In this video, we'll show you how to get the Kingpin Bowling Alley safe code, along with several others in the area.

recentItems.title: Minor Deity - Official Trailer
recentItems.description:
Take a look at world-building gameplay from Minor Deity in this trailer for the upcoming gridless interactive sandbox game. The Minor Deity trailer showcases terraforming, rivers, trees, roads, buildings, animals, and a peek at colony management. Minor Deity will be available on PC (Steam and Itch).

#IGN #gaming

recentItems.title: Artificial - Official Trailer (2027) Andrew Garfield, Monica Barbaro, Jason Schwartzman
recentItems.description:
Check out the new trailer for Artificial, an upcoming film starring Andrew Garfield, Yura Borisov, Monica Barbaro, Cooper Hoffman, Jason Schwartzman, Ike Barinholtz, and Mark Rylance.

From Luca Guadagnino comes the story of OpenAI and a two decade artificial intelligence arms race. When a computer scientist and AI pioneer Professor Geoffrey Hinton makes a breakthrough they are certain will alter humanity forever, Sam Altman, Elon Musk and the most prominent figures in Silicon Valley race to become part of their vision. As the technology becomes more powerful and more valuable than anyone ever imagined, a battle wages over who should control the tech that could change the fate of humanity.

Artificial, directed by Luca Guadagnino, opens in select theaters on December 25, 2026, and in theaters everywhere on January 8, 2027.

recentItems.title: Adapt - Official Playtest Gameplay Trailer | DevGamm Awards 2026
recentItems.description:
Take a look at gameplay from Adapt in this trailer for the upcoming survival sandbox game. To survive, you must guide your species through a constantly changing world in Adapt. Compete with strange creatures for food and territory, and find your niche through careful evolutionary choices. The real question is not if you can survive, but for how long. Adapt will be available on Steam. If you're interested, you can play the latest additions to Adapt in the current Steam playtest.

#Adapt #Gaming #IGN

recentItems.title: Metal Slug Ultimate Collection - Official Metal Slug 1 & 2 Story Recap Trailer
recentItems.description:
Get a recap of the stories of Metal Slug 1 and Metal Slug 2 in this latest trailer for the Metal Slug Ultimate Collection, the upcoming collection for the 2D run-and-gun series. 

The Metal Slug Ultimate Collection includes Metal Slug (1996), Metal Slug 2 (1998), Metal Slug X (1999), Metal Slug 3 (2000), Metal Slug 4 (2002), Metal Slug 5 (2003), Metal Slug Advance (2004), Metal Slug 6 (2006), Metal Slug 7 (2008), and the Metal Slug Location Test Build. 

Metal Slug Ultimate Collection will be available on Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, and Steam in 2027.
